lines.en: I push forward with my head down.
My horns scrape the ground.

lines.zh: 我低着头一步步压过去
lines.en: I lower my head and press forward.
My hooves land heavily.
I pace the edge of the pasture.
Something bulges under my fleece.
I climb the grassy slope.
I stop and paw the ground.
I veer toward you.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，角也跟着晃
lines.en: My gait sways, and my horns with it.

lines.zh: 我从篱笆的缺口挤进来
lines.en: I push through a gap in the fence.
I turn my head slowly to find you.
I shake every couple of steps.
I rub along the base of the fence.

lines.zh: 我的影子比一般的羊大
lines.en: My shadow is bigger than a sheep's should be.
I bear down, step by step.
I stand in the grass with my head low.
The growth on me pulses.
I listen to your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有角在晃
lines.en: I hold still, only my horns moving.
I have trampled a patch of grass.
I work my jaw at nothing.
I am waiting for a chance to charge.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里的气打在地上
lines.en: My breath slaps the ground.
This meadow is not disordered enough.
I lift a forehoof and set it down.
I count whoever else is in the pasture.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西在找什么
lines.en: The thing on me is searching for something.
I turn slowly around.
The grass here has no taste.
I stare one way for a long time.
Grass sweeps across my nose.
You are standing in my pasture.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让你看我的角
lines.en: I lower my head so you see my horns.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西也看见你了
lines.en: The growth on me has seen you too.
Come a little nearer to me.

lines.zh: 我的角对着你，眼却偏开
lines.en: My horns face you, my eyes slide away.
You are still clean-smelling.
I grunt, and it does not sound like a sheep.

lines.zh: 你正对着我，挡了我的冲线
lines.en: Standing dead ahead blocks my run-up.
I am measuring my run-up.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子已经准备好了
lines.en: My hooves are ready.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我会好受些
lines.en: Step back a little and I will feel better.
There is only us on this meadow.
My forelegs give and I lurch.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我的脊背上
lines.en: That landed on my spine.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西缩了一下
lines.en: The growth on me flinches.
I back off half a pace.
A muffled bellow leaves my throat.
My horns are knocked aside.
My four legs still hold the ground.
My hooves are trembling.

lines.zh: 皮下的东西替我接着疼
lines.en: The thing under my hide takes the pain.
I keep my eyes fixed on you.
This is not grass at all.
I will not eat a bite of it.
Lay it down on the ground.
I sniff and walk off.

lines.zh: 这东西对身上的它有用吗
lines.en: Would that help the thing on me?
I lower my head to it.
I bite it, and it is wrong.
Do not pull your hand back.
I am not really hungry now.
This is really too little.
I shovel it away with my snout.
It tastes bitter in my mouth.
Nothing left in my mouth but the taste of soil.
You hold it for now.
My horn nearly caught it.
I have no appetite.
You hit my horns.
All four legs are rooted in the dirt.
You are knocked askew.
My hoof lands on your foot.
The clash draws a growl from me.

lines.zh: 身上的东西一下就紧了
lines.en: The growth on me tightens.
I step back, then push again.
That should move you.
I have not shifted a step.
Do not press yourself on me.

lines.zh: 我身上这东西不是我的伴
lines.en: This thing on me is not a mate.

lines.zh: 这些事我早不放在心上
lines.en: I stopped caring about that long ago.
I only want to ram things.
That question need not come up.
I lower my head and ignore you.
I turn my whole body away.
I am alone in this pasture.
The growth moves, and it annoys me.
I paw the ground twice.
I toss my head and walk off.
I root it up with my snout.
It is all over with soil.
I bite it, and it will not give.
I drag it two steps.
Whoever dropped it, I keep it first.
It rolls onto my horn.
I press it into the dirt.
I bite down, then let it go.
I kick it to one side.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子把它刨到一边
lines.en: I scrape it aside with a hoof.
You are in my charge line.
My head is already down.
Your name is already noted.
The growth on me points at you too.
I paw the ground twice.
You are less than ten paces away.
I have hoped for this a long time.
This charge takes all of me.
The moment you stopped, I lowered my head.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声闷吼
lines.en: A muffled roar rolls from my throat.
I build speed step by step.
I keep pawing the ground.

lines.zh: 你退开一步我就追一步
lines.en: You step back, I give chase.
My horns stay on you.
The growth on me is drawing tight.
Every hoofbeat adds speed.
I measure the remaining steps.
The fence sits right behind you.
I have come round to your flank.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，又重新蓄力
lines.en: I pause, then gather again.
I slam the whole of me into you.
My horns dig into your ribs.
You are thrown off your feet.
Both horns drove into your chest.
My own head aches from it.
Head down, I add one more blow.
You are down on the ground.
The growth on me is trembling.
There is blood on my horns.
That will slow you a while.

lines.zh: 坡上的草被我撞开一条道
lines.en: I knock a path through the slope grass.

lines.zh: 草场上多了一个歪影子
lines.en: A crooked shadow joins the meadow.
My head is low; the horns come first.
The growth on me is still moving.
The grass here grows tall enough.
I flatten a small patch.
I raise my head and scan around.

lines.zh: 我从篱笆缺口挤进来的
lines.en: I came in through the fence gap.
The wind spreads my smell.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等一个能撞的
lines.en: I wait here for something to ram.
Fire singes my wool, and it hurts.
I rolled from the slope into the ditch.

lines.zh: 泥浆灌满我的两个鼻孔
lines.en: Slurry fills both my nostrils.
The blast throws me into the fence.
The arrow shaft still quivers in my wool.

lines.zh: 魔法让身上的东西乱动
lines.en: Magic sets the growth writhing.
I have eaten this pasture bare.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and I jerk.
The ground under me is gone.
